project: Reliable LLM Agents for Routing and Triage

utility.domain_description: Cross-domain handling for underspecified or ambiguous input

labels.name: Clarification Needed
labels.definition: Use when the request is too vague to route without follow-up questions. This includes vague concept requests (e.g., 'explain this') or vague debugging requests without specific errors/code (e.g., 'My script isn't working', 'The output is wrong').

labels.name: Concept Explanation
labels.definition: Requests to explain general computer science concepts (e.g., 'What is a pointer?'). The user MUST name a specific concept. Do NOT use for asking if a concept is on an exam (route to Exam Prep), defining assignment rubric terms (route to Assignment Policy), or requesting exact homework solutions (route to Escalation).

labels.name: Debugging & Code Troubleshooting
labels.definition: Requests to fix logic or runtime errors in student-written code. The user must provide a specific error message or code snippet. Excludes environment/installation errors (route to Course Logistics), autograder point deductions (route to Assignment Policy), and vague 'code broken' complaints (route to Clarification Needed).

labels.name: Assignment & Grading Policy
labels.definition: Inquiries about assignment rules, late policies, submission formats, or autograder point deductions. Includes requests to clarify grading rubric terminology (e.g., 'Does PEP 8 matter?', 'What counts as hardcoding here?').

labels.name: Exam & Assessment Prep
labels.definition: Questions about exam formats, permitted materials, study guides, practice questions, or asking if specific topics/concepts will be tested on an upcoming assessment.

labels.name: Course Logistics & Environment Setup
labels.definition: Questions about schedules, office hours, platform access, or installing software. Includes troubleshooting errors during environment setup, software installation, or issues with course-provided tooling (e.g., Docker crashing, pip install failing).

labels.name: Instructor/TA Escalation
labels.definition: Overrides other categories for sensitive issues requiring human intervention. Includes academic dishonesty (asking for exact homework/exam solutions), formal grade disputes (e.g., 'TA graded me unfairly'), plagiarism flags, harassment, and personal/medical emergencies.

labels.name: Scheduling & Appointments
labels.definition: Requests to book, cancel, reschedule, or check the status of an upcoming medical appointment.

labels.name: Insurance & Billing
labels.definition: Inquiries regarding accepted insurance networks, payment methods, copays, out-of-pocket estimates, or explanations of medical bills.

labels.name: Facility & General Information
labels.definition: Questions about clinic operating hours, physical location, parking availability, visitor policies, or general contact information.

labels.name: Pharmacy & Prescription Logistics
labels.definition: Administrative requests regarding prescription refill status, pharmacy hours, or how to transfer a prescription to a new location.

labels.name: Human Staff Review Needed
labels.definition: Ambiguous, complex, or privacy-sensitive administrative requests that require review by a human receptionist or patient advocate. This includes medical records requests, patient grievances, legal or HIPAA-related inquiries, staff complaints, proxy authorization, and documentation requests. Use this label when the request involves sensitive administrative action that cannot be resolved by information alone. Do NOT use this label for standard appointment booking, prescription requests, or billing questions.

labels.name: Urgent Escalation
labels.definition: Queries containing cues of acute physical distress, potential medical emergencies, or serious emotional/psychiatric distress (including suicidal ideation, self-harm, or expressions of immediate personal danger), triggering an immediate recommendation to contact emergency services or a crisis helpline.
